name: Aratech (transport group)
description: Aratech was a group of three MB-C1 medium transports. All three of their cargo contained weapon systems. They were present at Camen Spaceport when Merte, the Hurrim Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, was stolen by two members of Dunari's coalition escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of Preybird-class starfighters.
